results.title: Are we all racists?
results.overview: In this unprecedented primetime program, 50 volunteers take part in experiments without knowing that the aim of the program is to understand the unconscious mechanisms that can lead us to discriminatory behavior. Because if they knew, it would bias the results of the experiments.

results.title: Freedom
results.overview: Two astronauts try to rescue forbidden art treasures from a totalitarian regime by smuggling them on their mission to Jupiter. During their long space journey they then encounter some mutual disagreements.

results.title: Dawid Podsiadło - zapis koncertu 360° ze Stadionu Śląskiego w Chorzowie
results.original_title: Dawid Podsiadło - zapis koncertu 360° ze Stadionu Śląskiego w Chorzowie
results.overview: Dawid Podsiadło - Record of a 360° concert from the Śląski Stadium in Chorzów is a cinematic record of the concert, realized with great panache and attention to every detail. Thanks to dozens of cameras placed around the stage and the audience will be able to admire the show from different perspectives and feel like at a real concert. Powerful sound, amazing scenery and the unique atmosphere of the Śląski Stadium - all this awaits viewers in the cinemas.

results.title: Singularity
results.overview: A college student, Benny, struggles with social anxiety and overthinking. Overwhelming amounts of anxious thoughts always cause him to freeze up when he’s in a social setting. Benny feels that his anxieties are isolating him, and seeks to battle them by stepping far out of his comfort zone.

results.title: Veil of Chu
results.overview: The film mainly tells the story of Wu Qi, a Faqiu inheritor played by Julat Kutilai, and his close friend Wang Fugui. While searching for the whereabouts of their master, they accidentally clash with Lin Zhenzhen, the daughter of a warlord. Unexpectedly, all three fall into the scheme of the villain Hong Ling. After a negotiation, the three forces enter the tomb with their own agendas. Wu Qi uses the secret Faqiu techniques to locate the tomb and cleverly 破解 (break) the mechanisms, leading everyone to escape death in the tomb.

results.title: His Monster
results.overview: When his young daughter is mysteriously swept out to sea, a struggling alcoholic believes it to be a monster that attacked her. James remains alone, searching the woods and finding nothing. But when people around him start dying, only he believes what it is that’s killing them.

results.title: Stardom Nighter 2025 in Korakuen Oct.
results.overview: Stardom Nighter 2025 in Korakuen Oct. was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on October 27, 2025 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

results.title: If I Run
results.overview: Casey Cox is a woman on the run after discovering her best friend Brent has been murdered—and she is being framed for it. Not knowing who to trust, Casey flees, using her intelligence and resourcefulness to stay hidden and the signs of divine guidance to help her in her journey. Meanwhile, Dylan Roberts, a war-weary veteran and private investigator with PTSD, is hired to track her down. As Dylan digs deeper into the case, he begins to suspect that Casey might actually be innocent and that the real story is far more complex—and dangerous—than it first appeared.

results.title: Downey Wrote That
